newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Feb crude steel output up 7.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Feb crude steel output up 7.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's crude steel output rose 7.5 percent in February from a year earlier to 8.28 million tonnes, the Japan Iron and Steel Federation said on Thursday.
The February figure was down 5.1 percent from January, the industry group said in a statement.
February output of tin plate was 123,600 tonnes, down 1.6 percent year-on-year and down 1.5 percent month-on-month, the federation said.
Production of galvanised steel sheet in February was 1.01 million tonnes, up 11.9 percent year-on-year but down 4.8 percent month-on-month.
Japan's crude steel production in the period from April 1996 to February 1997 fell 0.2 percent from the same period a year earlier to 86.40 million tonnes, it said.
